effect: The caps produced a closed discovery case and completed storage preparation for this chapter; no further action was needed.
reaction: The closure is sensible, but the chapter ended before I could make a meaningful decision about protecting the sample.

mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the case gave a concrete final action to the effort to preserve the body and its surrounding ice, although the result was brief.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sole combination felt perfunctory: its result simply confirmed the goal without adding detail or a new challenge.

surprise.text: I was surprised the chapter ended immediately after closing the ports; I expected additional storage preparation.

arbitrary.text: The caps have a clear physical purpose, but with only one offered action there was no real choice to work through.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the body and its context reach Earth, though this chapter alone offered little engaging gameplay.
